item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 28/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The cloud band covering the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea will thin out gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be mild over the region. A surge of northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China later on Sunday. It will be windy over the region in the following couple of days. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be cool in the morning over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
